title: Add json2proto-lab feature
body:
This PR introduces a new `json2proto-lab` CLI command and TUI that converts JSON strings into Protobuf `proto3` schema definitions. It accurately handles data types, nested dictionaries (creating nested messages), arrays (creating `repeated` fields), and performs automatic camel-case to snake-case field conversion commonly expected in Protobuf definitions. Tests are included for both backend and TUI functionality.
